code_hints: If landing on '/' or no PLP tiles after 4s, navigate to the first start_url PLP and continue.
On every page load, attempt to click cookie consent: query '#onetrust-accept-btn-handler' or '.onetrust-accept-btn-handler'. Ignore errors if absent.
Wait for PLP presence via any of: 'a[data-test="product-tile-link"]' or 'a[href*="/products/"]' before scraping.
Extract PLP product links via querySelectorAll on the union of item_link selectors; resolve to absolute URLs; keep only those matching '/en-jp/' and '/products/'.
Handle pagination by clicking buttons matching next_page selectors up to a safety cap (e.g., 5 times) with a short wait for new tiles between clicks.
On PDP, wait for title then price; if no visible price matches, parse JSON-LD for offers.price as a fallback.
Guard region: after any navigation, if current URL does not start with 'https://www.moncler.com/en-jp/', rewrite via the normalize rule and retry. Abort if redirected to monclergroup.com.
rationale: The failure occurred because the homepage (/en-jp/) is not a PLP and may show region/cookie overlays, so product tiles never appear. Directly targeting stable category PLPs (men/women outerwear) avoids menu interactions and geolocation modals. Added robust, domain-specific selectors for product tiles and PDP fields, plus cookie-consent handling. URL normalization and allow/deny rules ensure we stay on the en-jp storefront and avoid accidental redirects to monclergroup.com or other regions.
